create_dataset_video_dataset: create a VideoDataset instance for video alignment tasks with configurable phase and feature retrieval modes
build_dataset_madonna: build a Madonna dataset subclass that loads ground truth pairs and splits by connected components
build_dataset_vcdb: build a VCDB dataset subclass that splits videos by source directory into train and validation folds
read_gt_dataset: read ground truth annotations from .align or .dat files and return video lists with overlapping pairs
check_data_dataset: check that a dataset directory contains required videos, annotations, and ground truth files
compute_offset_videos: compute temporal offset between two video entries using global and begin timestamps
get_timestamps_fps: convert frame indices to timestamps given original and destination frame rates
